summary: ITER33 — Network Capital Promotions extension (User-facing /promotions/me page + daily login modal + cross-platform '100 Network Points = R10 ZAR' conversion banners). Backend: 16/16 pytest PASS (auth-gating on all 3 new endpoints, response shape, breakdown counters, rank=null-when-zero, conversion math 500*0.10=R50, SAST '+02:00' on now_sast, force-active 24x7 promo → post_create → stats.breakdown.posts>=1 + rank=1 integer, regression /api/admin/promotions list, /api/admin/promotions-summary, /api/promotions/active). Frontend (UI live-tested via injected token): promo-welcome-modal appears on first daily visit, learn-toggle reveals 4-row learn-content, CTA-primary navigates to /promotions/me, CTA-dismiss & close set localStorage 'nc_promo_modal_last_shown' = today's YYYY-MM-DD, reload same day does NOT re-show modal, my-promotions-conversion pill shows '100 Network Points = R10 ZAR' with SAST schedule visible, /admin/promotions banner shows '100 Network Points = R10 ZAR · Official rate applied to all promotion rewards', /ambassadors/me hero card pill shows '100 Network Points = R10 ZAR', quick-promotions tile present on /profile and onClick handler navigates (JS .click() confirmed working).
action_items: (Carry-over from iter32, still unfixed) server.py:8195 — `async for uid in db.promotion_events.distinct(...)` is a latent bug; Motor's distinct() returns a coroutine→List, not async-iterable. Will swallow under broad except → no notifications sent on window-open. Fix: `for uid in await db.promotion_events.distinct('user_id', {'promotion_id': promo['id']}):`

(Cosmetic) Profile quick-tile uses `onClick={() => (window.location.href = q.path)}` which causes full-page reload (breaks SPA state). Consider migrating to react-router `navigate()` like PromotionsWelcomeModal does — better UX and consistent.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L8197-8230 (/users/me/promotions): N+1 — `_user_promo_stats` + `_user_rank_in_promo` called per promo in a Python for-loop; `_user_rank_in_promo` itself runs the full `_participant_aggregate` per promo. For 5 active promos × any number of participants, that's 5 sequential full aggregates just to compute one user's rank. Recommend computing all per-promo aggregates in parallel with asyncio.gather, OR caching `_participant_aggregate` results in _PROMO_CACHE (already refreshed every 60s).
server.py L8242 (/promotions/me/login-summary): Same N+1 pattern — _user_promo_stats per promo serially. Same fix.

server.py L8261-8270: top_ambassadors aggregate sorts by network_score+monthly_score but the spec mentions 'leaderboard'/'top contributors' — confirm the intent matches the existing /api/admin/ambassadors-leaderboard (which sorts by total_contribution). Mismatch could surprise users vs the dedicated leaderboard view.
PromotionsWelcomeModal.js: localStorage gate is checked once at mount; if user keeps the SPA open past midnight SAST, modal won't re-arm. Minor — fine for MVP.
ProfilePage.js L702: `window.location.href = q.path` for ALL quick-access tiles causes a full page reload on every tile click — degrades SPA experience. Recommended to switch to useNavigate().
MyPromotionsPage.js: No empty-state when /api/users/me/promotions returns promotions:[]; user sees an unstyled blank gap. Not tested live (env has seed M/W/F so list is non-empty).
